name: OpenWorker
description: Runs a local desktop coworker that plans and completes tasks across your files, terminal and 25+ connected apps, with approval gates, an audit trail and your own model keys or Ollama.

skills.name: Security Review
skills.description: Scans a codebase and its dependencies with semgrep plus model reasoning, then re-scans and diff-reviews proposed fixes before you approve.

skills.name: Work From Slack
skills.description: Opens a desktop session when you mention @OpenWorker in a Slack channel and posts the finished answer back as a thread reply.

skills.name: Scheduled Automations
skills.description: Runs recurring work such as a morning brief, weekly report or channel watch on a schedule, with full transcripts kept in the app.

skills.name: Sandboxed Commands
skills.description: Runs each agent's shell and file tools in an NVIDIA OpenShell Linux container, or the built-in macOS sandbox, with an allow-listed network.
